Hair loss is also known as alopecia, which is caused because of an interruption in the cycle of hair development. Heredity, hormonal changes, and medical conditions or medications are the main causes of hair loss. The hair growth cycle consists of three stages. The first stage is anagen stage, in which hair develops effectively. The next stage is catagen stage, in this stage hair stops developing and isolates from its follicle. The catagen stage keeps going for around 10 days. The last stage of hair development is telogen stage, the follicle rests for a few months, and after that the hair falls out. The following anagen stage starts as another hair develops in a similar follicle.

Causes Of Hair Loss-:

  • Unhealthy diet
  • Deep stress
  • Hormonal changes
  • Pregnancy
  • Protein deficiency
  • Thyroid diseases
  • Some other medications and surgeries

Most Common Types of Hair loss

Androgenic Alopecia is the most common type of hair loss, affecting more than 50 million men and 30 million women in the United States. Androgenic alopecia is commonly called as male pattern baldness or female pattern baldness. Heredity is the main cause of androgenic alopecia, yet it can be cured with medication or surgery.

Male Pattern Baldness

In men, male pattern baldness can start after puberty. Afterwards, numerous people with male pattern baldness eventually become bald. Female Pattern Baldness In ladies, hair gradually diminishes everywhere throughout the scalp. Aging is main reason of hair loss in women. Female pattern baldness can make hair thinner drastically.

Telogen Effluvium

Telogen Effluvium happens when large amount of follicles on the scalp enter the resting phase of the hair development cycle,which is called telogen. Then, the next development stage does not start. This makes hair fall out everywhere throughout the scalp without new hair development. The various reasons of hair loss are thyroid diseases, childbirth, surgery, and other medications. Telogen effluvium might also occur due to vitamin, mineral, and iron deficiency.

Anagen Effluvium

Anagen effluvium hair loss is caused due to medical surgery related to chemotherapy. These intense and quick acting medications kill cancer cells, but they may also prove harmful for hair follicle production in the scalp and different parts of the body. Doctors offer prescription to help the hair grow back more rapidly.

Alopecia Areata

Alopecia areata is a condition, in which the body’s immune system attacks healthy tissues. It includes the hair follicles too. This condition may influence grown- ups and youngsters. In this condition, hair loss can start suddenly without warning. In the alopecia areata, hair from the scalp typically falls out in small patches .It also shows up in eyebrows and eyelashes. After some time, this disorder may prompt alopecia totalis or complete hair loss. Experts treat this disease with medication that might be helpful to grow hair faster.
